description:
You are a computer systems analyst who has just finalized a system architecture diagram in EdrawMax. You need to share this diagram with two audiences: the project manager needs a PDF copy for the formal design review document, and the development team needs a PNG image for their wiki page.

Export the currently open diagram to both PDF and PNG formats:

1. Export the diagram as a PDF file and save it to: ~/Documents/exports/diagram_export.pdf
2. Export the diagram as a PNG image and save it to: ~/Documents/exports/diagram_export.png

The directory ~/Documents/exports/ already exists. Use EdrawMax's built-in export functionality to create both files. Both exported files should contain the full diagram content.

Note: Watermarks from the trial version are acceptable.
